## Validation

- [ ] Relevant CI passes, or the reason CI is not applicable is documented.
- [ ] Hardware validation is recorded, or marked not applicable with a reason.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated together when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] Firmware and SD-card artifact impact is documented; checksums are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Public text, logs, commits, and artifacts contain no credentials, private data, or host-specific paths.
- [ ] Attached logs are minimal and redacted.
